name: gangs
summary: A pack of hyenas, not a platoon. They spread wider than anyone, they get around you and keep circling so no single vehicle eats the whole volley, they send one rat rod to pull you onto the rest, and they have no word for withdraw.

movement.why: the pack circles: guns pointing out, engines running
strung out across the ground, eyes everywhere, nobody in a line
everyone fires from wherever they stopped; nobody waits to be told
spread out and all over them: one shell should only ever get one of us
the pack fans out and comes at you head on
loose and wide: harder to shell, harder to guess where the next one comes from
